obs: mod-comms initialized — observing per ICS-205/205A + standard fireground radio terminology; checklist mod-comms-checklist.md

Settings tab contains Department Connection, Theme, Apparatus Types, Data Management, Reference Materials, Logout — no ICS-205 / radio plan / frequency / talkgroup / Net assignment surface anywhere in the app (Item 7 baseline; app.js source grep for radio|frequency|talkgroup|tactical net|ICS-205|comms returns zero matches)

Operation start/end + returned-equipment timestamps use Date.toLocaleString() with browser default — on en-US locale this renders 12-hour AM/PM (verified 'PM' suffix on probe of Date('2026-05-17T14:30:00').toLocaleTimeString()); no toLocaleString('en-US',{hour12:false}) calls anywhere in app.js — violates fireground 24h discipline (Item 10)

surface: Add Shore Point modal — Division field (index.html line 387)
obs: spDivision is free-text <input type=text> with placeholder 'e.g. A' — accepts ANY string including 'north side', 'front', 'rear-left'; no constraint enforcing NIMS A/B/C/D convention; radio call 'Division Charlie' could correspond to a card stored as 'south side' (Item 1)

surface: Add Shore Point modal — Building field (index.html line 382)
obs: spBuilding is free-text input placeholder 'e.g. Building A' — Surfside scenario calls this 'Pinecrest Tower'; on radio, building reference is 'Pinecrest' or 'Building Alpha' — app does not enforce single canonical label, so two participants can label cards 'Pinecrest', 'Building A', 'Tower' for same building (Item 1)

Status pill 'Strut Placed' (line 688) does not match common fireground radio call 'strut set' / 'strut in'; 'Pending — No Equipment' radio-spoken is awkward; 'In Process' is ambiguous on radio (cutting? assembling?); participant will have to translate every status read aloud (Item 3)

Apparatus naming Item 2 baseline — 38 apparatus loaded; no two share a base name (Engine 1..18, Ladder 1..4, Rescue 1..3, Squad 1, Tower 1, USAR-Alpha, USAR-Bravo, Heavy 1, BC-1, BC-2, ACOO-1, PIO-1, EMS-1, EMS-2, TF-State Cache, TF-Fed-{Alpha,Bravo,Charlie} Cache) — BUT 4 records collide on suffix 'Cache' after TF-prefix strip; on radio, ambiguous 'Cache from IC' requires full TF qualifier discipline

38 apparatus visible are TF-PARENT caches only — Type-I TF internal apparatus (TF-State-Rescue-A, TF-Fed-Alpha-Rescue-A etc.) are NOT pre-seeded; if participants instantiate them during OPs, the Rescue-A token will collide across TFs causing radio ambiguity (life-threatening on the fireground); app has no apparatus-name uniqueness validation (Item 2 forward-watch)

Bottom nav has 4 buttons: Quick Find / Operations / Inventory / Settings — no dedicated 'Command' tab; org-chart + role-assign UI is nested inside Operations tab per architecture; therefore no surface exists to bind Command-Net / Tactical-Net / Support-Net assignments per ICS leader role (Item 8 baseline absent)
